title: For each instance availability zone and VM state (including per-availabilit
question: For each instance availability zone and VM state (including per-availability-zone subtotals and a grand total) for non-deleted instances hosted on “prime-35” (joined via instance UUID to both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), list the availability zone, VM state, number of instances, and earliest instance creation time, and also show the number of completed migrations per VM state for instances hosted on “blaze8-12”, along with the overall average of these per-VM-state completed-migration counts and the completed-migration count specifically for shelved_offloaded instances. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.created_at
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'prime-35' AND i.deleted = 0
),
grp AS (
  SELECT availability_zone, vm_state, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(created_at) AS earliest
  FROM base GROUP BY availability_zone, vm_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT availability_zone, 'SUBTOTAL' AS vm_state, COUNT(*), MIN(created_at)
  FROM base GROUP BY availability_zone
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'GRAND TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', COUNT(*), MIN(created_at)
  FROM base
),
mig AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
avgc AS (SELECT AVG(completed_migrations) AS avg_completed FROM mig),
shelved AS (SELECT completed_migrations FROM mig WHERE vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded')
SELECT g.availability_zone, g.vm_state, g.n AS instance_count, g.earliest,
       m.completed_migrations, a.avg_completed, s.completed_migrations AS shelved_offloaded_completed
FROM grp g
LEFT JOIN mig m ON m.vm_state = g.vm_state
CROSS JOIN avgc a
CROSS JOIN shelved s
ORDER BY g.availability_zone, g.vm_state;

  FROM instances i
  INNER JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.dest_compute = 'blaze8-12' AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
migration_summary AS (
  SELECT AVG(completed_migrations) AS avg_completed_migrations,
         SUM(CASE WHEN vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' THEN completed_migrations ELSE 0 END) AS shelved_offloaded_migrations
  FROM migration_counts
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN i.availability_zone IS NULL AND i.vm_state IS NULL THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
       ELSE i.availability_zone END AS availability_zone,
  CASE WHEN i.vm_state IS NULL AND i.availability_zone IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
       ELSE i.vm_state END AS vm_state,
  i.instance_count,
  i.earliest_creation_time,
  COALESCE(mc.completed_migrations, 0) AS completed_migrations_blaze8_12,
  ms.avg_completed_migrations,
  ms.shelved_offloaded_migrations
FROM instance_stats i
LEFT JOIN migration_counts mc ON i.vm_state = mc.vm_state
CROSS JOIN migration_summary ms
ORDER BY (i.availability_zone IS NULL), i.availability_zone, (i.vm_state IS NULL), i.vm_state;

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.created_at
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'prime-35' AND i.deleted = 0
),
grp AS (
  SELECT availability_zone, vm_state, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(created_at) AS earliest
  FROM base GROUP BY availability_zone, vm_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT availability_zone, 'SUBTOTAL' AS vm_state, COUNT(*), MIN(created_at)
  FROM base GROUP BY availability_zone
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'GRAND TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', COUNT(*), MIN(created_at)
  FROM base
),
mig AS (
  SELECT i.vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations
  FROM instances i
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
avgc AS (SELECT AVG(completed_migrations) AS avg_completed FROM mig),
shelved AS (SELECT completed_migrations FROM mig WHERE vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded')
SELECT g.availability_zone, g.vm_state, g.n AS instance_count, g.earliest,
       m.completed_migrations, a.avg_completed, s.completed_migrations AS shelved_offloaded_completed
FROM grp g
LEFT JOIN mig m ON m.vm_state = g.vm_state
CROSS JOIN avgc a
CROSS JOIN shelved s
ORDER BY g.availability_zone, g.vm_state;
